_comment: Quality gate scoring configuration for design brief and final design validation.

checks.name: Squint Test
criteria: Readable at 150x150px thumbnail size
Instant category recognition (what IS this product)
Instant message recognition (what does it SAY)
Instant audience recognition (who is this FOR)
Hero element occupies >40% of composition

checks.name: Intersection Formula
criteria: Targets a specific identity/subculture (not broad category)
References a specific relatable situation (not generic statement)
Applies a distinct micro-aesthetic (named trend, not 'modern')
Niche description is 5+ words with specificity
Not in the banned generic niches list

checks.name: Trend Alignment
criteria: Uses colors from a Rising or Peak trend palette
Typography matches recommended pairing for the aesthetic
Illustration style matches the trend's visual language
Motifs are specific to the trend (not generic clip art)

checks.name: Thumbnail Contrast
criteria: Minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio between text and background
Maximum 2 visual focal points (1 preferred)
No fine detail that becomes noise at thumbnail scale
Works on both light and dark product blanks (if apparel)

checks.name: Mockup Quality
criteria: Lifestyle staging per mockup standards (not flat white default)
Realistic fabric texture or material visible
Warm ambient lighting (not clinical flash)
Context shows product in use (not floating in void)

checks.name: Differentiation
criteria: Visually distinct from top 5 competitors in same niche search
Unique angle or twist not seen in first page of Etsy results
Does not replicate an existing bestseller's exact composition

auto_fail_patterns: Raw unedited AI-generated imagery (glossy, plastic texture, floating artifacts)
Generic broad niche ('Dog Lover', 'Coffee Mom', 'Gym Rat', 'Best Dad Ever')
Default POD provider mockup (white background, flat product render)
More than 2 fonts in a single design
Clip art or stock vector assemblage without cohesive style
Pure white (#FFFFFF) backgrounds on planners or wall art
Crowded composition with no clear visual hierarchy
